title: Listen and Choose a Response — Neighbors

questions.stem: Would you mind feeding my cat while I'm away?

options.A: Not at all. Just leave me the key and instructions.
options.B: My cat is about six years old.
options.C: I'm away from my desk right now.
options.D: Yes, I'd mind it a lot.

questions.explanation: 'Not at all' accepts a 'Would you mind' request. 'Yes, I'd mind' refuses awkwardly, and the others repeat 'cat' or 'away'.
questions.speaker: m6
